changelog:
Initial release of directory-submissions skill.

- Guides users in submitting products to high-impact startup, SaaS, AI, agent, MCP, and review directories for backlinks, domain rating, and discovery.
- Provides a step-by-step readiness assessment to ensure landing pages, assets, and supporting pages are in place before submissions.
- Outlines a tiered catalog of directory types and prioritizes submissions with the right positioning for each audience.
- Includes three core rules for maximizing discovery and backlink value (foundation before submission, destination pages before directories, and tailored positioning).
- References templates and checklists for directory selection, positioning variants, and submission tracking.
summary: When the user wants to submit their product to startup, SaaS, AI, agent, MCP, no-code, or review directories for backlinks, domain rating, and discovery. Also use when the user mentions "directory submissions," "submit to directories," "backlinks from directories," "list my product," "submit to Product Hunt," "BetaList," "TAAFT," "Futurepedia," "G2 listing," "Capterra listing," "AlternativeTo," "SaaSHub," "AI directories," "MCP registry," "agent directory," "dofollow backlinks," "launch directories," or "directory tracker." Use this whenever someone is planning the directory layer of a product launch or an ongoing backlink campaign. For the broader launch moment, see launch. For programmatic SEO pages that should live behind these backlinks, see programmatic-seo. For AI citation optimization, see ai-seo.
